items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I made some with Al Marika.

ctx.x: And did you make any more records until the 1940s?

Yeah, after I left Bruner. Uh huh. Yeah, I made some records with Shockey. I think I made some with Shockey. I made some with Al Marika. That's about all. Remember any of the tunes you made with Shockey? Huh? Remember any tunes you made with Shockey? No, I don't remember any of them.
Was that in late years or was that during the 30s or what? That was in later years. That's my daughter. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
